subject: Your Sophia academic review pack is ready (SOPHIA-COMMERCIAL-DEMO-001)
body:
Hello Controlled Sophia Customer,

Your human-reviewed Sophia diagnostic pack is attached. It contains reviewer commentary, a technical reference audit, literature discovery leads and a claim-to-source ledger.

The pack is diagnostic support, not a rewritten submission. Please verify every retained source against the full publication and keep all final wording and academic decisions your own.
